name: Carregar usuário
query:
SELECT
  u.id AS "userId",
  u.name,
  u.email,
  u.sector_id AS "sectorId",
  s.name AS "sectorName",
  u.active,
  u.is_master AS "isMaster",
  CASE
    WHEN u.is_master = TRUE THEN (
      SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(p_all.code ORDER BY p_all.name), '[]'::json)
      FROM permissions p_all WHERE p_all.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
    )
    ELSE COALESCE((
      SELECT json_agg(p.code ORDER BY p.code)
      FROM user_permissions up
      JOIN permissions p ON p.id = up.permission_id
      WHERE up.user_id = u.id AND p.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
    ), '[]'::json)
  END AS permissions
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN sectors s ON s.id = u.sector_id
WHERE u.id = '{{ $json.userId }}'::uuid
  AND u.active = TRUE
LIMIT 1;

assignments.name: user
assignments.value: ={{ ({ id: $json.userId, name: $json.name, email: $json.email, sectorId: $json.sectorId, sectorName: $json.sectorName, active: $json.active, isMaster: $json.isMaster, permissions: Array.isArray($json.permissions) ? $json.permissions : [] }) }}
